fields.description: Base URL of this site's QuickInsights FastAPI deployment, e.g. https://quickinsights.example.com. Each Frappe site should point at its own dedicated backend -- see the integration architecture doc's multi-site isolation section.
fields.label: FastAPI Base URL

fields.description: Shared secret used to sign the identity tokens this site issues to FastAPI. Never exposed to the browser or to any API response -- only read server-side when minting a token. Generate a new one instead of typing a memorable value.
fields.label: Identity Token Signing Secret

fields.description: How long a minted identity token stays valid before the React app / widget must silently mint a new one.
fields.label: Token Lifetime (minutes)

fields.description: When off, the widget bootstrap script never loads on any Desk page for anyone on this site -- independent of whether any individual user has a usable connection.
fields.label: Enable Floating Chat Widget

fields.options: Changes here take effect immediately for new identity tokens; existing tokens already issued remain valid until they expire.
